text:
amy_prodsec: Quick sync — pen test vendor asked for the evidence upload flow and KMS proxy window. We need to lock the upload window, confirm RBAC mapping for staging, and decide audit log sampling cadence. Tentative window: Tue 08:00-12:00 PT. Who owns gating and the audit exports?

sam_sre: I can own the gating and the ephemeral role swap. Need confirmation on which KMS key the vendor should use (staging-readroom-kms) and whether to provide a presigned S3 URL or direct upload to S3 with role-based putObject.

tarun_engineer: Prefer role-based upload + presigned for large artifacts. If we give a presigned URL, we should attach a short-lived tag that traces upload ID -> assessor id. Also want to enable object lock for the bucket during the window.

jenna_oncall: +1 for role-based. Oncall will watch logs. Can someone add a CloudWatch metric filter for PutObject events so I get paging if uploads suddenly spike?

amy_prodsec: Good. Action items:
- sam_sre: create ephemeral role and grant s3:PutObject, kms:Encrypt using arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/staging-readroom-kms (expiry 4h).
- tarun_engineer: prepare presigned URL flow and object-lock policy.
- jenna_oncall: add metric filter + runbook for upload anomalies.

sam_sre: Will create role and post the role ARN here. Also will wire KMS proxy (we'll use our kms-proxy service to issue envelope keys). Example command I tested locally: 
``` 
# request envelope key
curl -X POST https://kms-proxy.internal/v1/envelope -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"key_id":"staging-readroom-kms","alg":"AES-GCM-256","ttl":14400}'
```
Response contains base64 envelope_key used client-side for envelope encryption before upload.

amy_prodsec: Good note. For audit logging: we want a small sample set exported to SIEM immediately (first 10% of uploads) and full manifest exported after window close. Tarun, can you add a manifest file to S3 path s3://pt-evidence/staging/{run_id}/manifest.json listing objects + checksum + uploader?

tarun_engineer: Yup. I'll also emit a short CSV for the SIEM ingestion: timestamp, uploader, object_key, sha256. We'll use lambda to forward to splunk.

jenna_oncall: For retest coordination: vendor requested retest slots next Friday afternoon. We should reserve Fri 14:00-18:00 PT as a tentative retest window and flag owners for triage. Who's triage lead?

amy_prodsec: Assigning remediation triage to @tarun_engineer (primary) and @sam_sre (backup). Jenna will run oncall during the slot. We'll create JIRA epic RED-PT-202 to track fixes; please add owners and severity tags.

sam_sre: I'll also add a KMS access audit query in the runbook: 
``` 
filter @message like /Decrypt|GenerateDataKey/ and @logStream like /kms-proxy/ | stats count() by bin(1m)
```
Set alert threshold to >50 in 5m window.

amy_prodsec: Perfect. One more ask from compliance: they want RBAC mapping doc showing who can escalate upload permissions post-window. Tarun can you add a small table in the runbook with: role -> allowed ops -> escalation path -> Slack pgrp.

tarun_engineer: Will add. Also will include the presigned URL TTL (1h) and enforced IP allowlist (vendor static egress ranges).

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: kms-proxy v2.3 will rollout Tue 06:00 PT, 30m canary, then full rollout at 07:00 PT. Will post rollout runbook link when ready.

amy_prodsec: Great — recap of owners and deadlines:
- sam_sre: ephemeral role + KMS proxy config (today EOD)
- tarun_engineer: presigned flow + manifest + RBAC table (EOD)
- jenna_oncall: metric filters + pager runbook (EOD)
- ops-bot: rollout notice (auto)
We will confirm final vendor instructions by Monday 12:00 PT. If anything blocks, ping here or escalate to #eng-sre. :white_check_mark:

jenna_oncall: noted, will add pager schedule to the runbook and watch the canary. :eyes:

sam_sre: role ARN: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/pt-staging-upload-ephemeral (expires 2024-02-15T12:00:00Z). Posting presigned URL helper in a follow-up thread.

amy_prodsec: Thanks all — closing thread, moving actions to RED-PT-202. (reacts: :rocket:)
